sigWerErrors.reason: 'ek bilgi' (additional information) vs 'bilgi' (information) changes the nuance but not the core meaning; the request is still for information.
'alırım' (I will receive) vs 'alayım' (let me receive) is a minor grammatical difference, intent is preserved.
'aktarılıyorsa' (if it is being transferred) vs 'aktaramıyorsanız' (if you cannot transfer) reverses the condition and changes the meaning significantly.
'limitim' (my limit) vs 'limitimin' (of my limit) is a minor grammatical difference, does not affect the overall meaning.
